tokens.usage: Secondary button and filled field fill.

tokens.name: glass-fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled glass fill.

tokens.name: glass-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels and component sets.

tokens.name: glass-chrome
tokens.usage: Fixed navigation chrome that floats over scrolling content: sticky or floating navbar, site header. Dark is an ink tint, not white glass, so text-primary stays above 7:1 even over white content.

tokens.name: glass-chrome-panel
tokens.usage: Glass panels that float over moving or photographic content: dropdowns and the mobile menu under navigation chrome, and small plates laid over images. More see-through than glass-chrome so it still reads as glass; the 48px panel blur keeps text-primary at about 7:1 over white content in Dark.

tokens.name: glass-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and listboxes that pop over content: Select, MultiSelect and Combobox listboxes, Menu, DropdownButton and SplitButton panels. Nearly opaque so options stay legible over busy forms and cards; white glass in Light, an ink tint (neutral-950 at 90%) in Dark.

tokens.name: fill-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles sitting on a bg-inverse (brand blue) panel, such as booking channels on a call-to-action band. A clearly lighter tint of the panel so each card reads as its own surface; text stays text-inverse.

tokens.name: fill-on-inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fill for fill-on-inverse cards.

tokens.name: stroke-on-inverse
tokens.usage: 1px border for fill-on-inverse cards, so their edges hold on the brand blue panel in both themes.
